title: A relative file addressed by a RELATIVE KEY that is not part of the record
shapes: AIXA AIXARRD: SELECT SLOT-FILE ... ORGANIZATION IS RELATIVE / ACCESS MODE IS DYNAMIC / RELATIVE KEY IS WS-SLOT-NO
asserts: The SELECT is one file_control fact (select SLOT-FILE, assign SLOTS, organization RELATIVE, access_mode DYNAMIC, record_key null) carrying relative_key WS-SLOT-NO. The RELATIVE KEY is a working-storage item, not a field of SLOT-REC, and it is not a record_key: a RELATIVE file has no RECORD KEY.

citations.doc: Enterprise COBOL for z/OS 6.4 Language Reference (SC27-8713-03)
citations.quote: The RELATIVE KEY clause (format 3) identifies a data-name that specifies the relative record number for a specific logical record within a relative file.

citations.doc: Enterprise COBOL for z/OS 6.4 Language Reference (SC27-8713-03)
citations.quote: That is, the RELATIVE KEY is not part of the record.

citations.doc: Enterprise COBOL for z/OS 6.4 Language Reference (SC27-8713-03)
citations.quote: The position of each logical record in the file is determined by its relative record number.

citations.doc: Enterprise COBOL for z/OS 6.4 Programming Guide (SC27-8714-03)
citations.quote: Alternate indexes are not supported for VSAM RRDS.
